# Security Policy

Please report viewer vulnerabilities through GitHub Private Vulnerability
Reporting. Alternatively, email
[yaroslav.riabtsev@rwth-aachen.de](mailto:yaroslav.riabtsev@rwth-aachen.de).

Do not include private Arachne data, access tokens, or unpublished snapshot
contents in a public issue. Public-site issues that do not expose sensitive
information may use the normal issue tracker.

The supported code is the current `docs` integration branch and the latest
deployed Pages bundle. The demo is read-only: suspected canonical-data mutation
or writer-credential exposure belongs to the private Arachne/core incident
process rather than this viewer repository.
